title: Add Pollinations for Godot 4 to games
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Pollinations for Godot 4](https://github.com/davealan74/godot-pollinations) to games
- A Godot 4 editor addon that adds a global Pollinations node for GDScript. Call generate_text() , generate_image() and generate_speech() directly from any script to hit gen.pollinations.ai's text, imag

Fixes #15585, fixes #15579

gist.headline: The garden gets a game engine
gist.blurb: davealan74 brought Pollinations into Godot 4. Game scripts can ask for text, images, and speech without leaving GDScript.
gist.summary: Added davealan74's Pollinations for Godot 4 to the games listing; the editor addon provides a global Pollinations node with generate_text(), generate_image(), and generate_speech() calls to gen.pollinations.ai.
gist.impact: Godot 4 developers get a discoverable addon for calling Pollinations text, image, and speech generation directly from GDScript.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy game-editor desk with a Godot-inspired gear-face icon and one glowing Pollinations node branching to a speech bubble, picture, and sound wave. Polli, wearing a tiny game-developer headset, connects the node while pixel flowers grow around the cables; use mint and lavender for the game-engine imagery rather than bright blue.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art game-development nook, a glowing lime green (#ecf874) Pollinations node on a retro screen branches toward tiny text, picture, and sound sprites beside a pastel Godot-inspired gear face, while flowers curl around the cables. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny headset and happily connects the node, small-to-medium within the scene, strictly pixel art and never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky sprites, gentle CRT glow, and dark purple (#110518) outlines; nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
